snippet.title: CONFINED: Leaving OKB-134 - World Premiere Trailer | Harvest of Terror 2026
snippet.description:
CONFINED: Leaving OKB-134 is an intense horror/puzzle adventure game for PC and VR, set in an abandoned Soviet bunker. Seek safety by restoring power, lights, and machinery. Learn about the long-gone personnel, solve sinister riddles, and find a way to escape. But stay quiet... You’re not alone.

DEMO OUT NOW:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3195810/CONFINED_Leaving_OKB134_Demo/

Coming Q1 2027 for PC and VR
https://www.fiend-games.com/

Wishlist Now on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2816730/CONFINED_Leaving_OKB134/
---
Originally aired during HARVEST OF TERROR: a Horror Game Awards Showcase on Wednesday 7 October 2026.
---
